plan.title: SRC-AWD-012 — Award Vendor A and reject proposal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids directly on Master QCS.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Confirm both bidding vendors are present before awarding.
Confirm Vendor A's bid covers the 10 requested units.
Confirm Vendor A's rate is 100 per unit.
Confirm the lower bid ranks first while preserving the case's choice to award Vendor A instead.
Open the awarding page for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 units to Vendor A, the non-lowest bidder.
Verify one of two vendors is awarded and the proposal total is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Create the award proposal from the allocation.

args.goal: on the proposal page, verify the allocation shows Vendor A with 10 units at 100 each for a total of 1,000, fill all required proposal fields, and submit the proposal; stop when the submission is confirmed

steps.note: Complete the required proposal fields and submit the buyer-side proposal, including the allocation expected by the case.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, reject it with a remark, and confirm that no purchase order is created

Verify the buyer can start awarding again after the rejected proposal.
